# Set up environment and load data 
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(phytools)
library(ape)
library(treeio)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggnewscale)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cartography)
library(khroma)

# Import tree
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
Fasttree_VLOD_DP <- read.tree("Fastree_DP.tre")
Fasttree_VLOD_DP_mid <- midpoint.root(Fasttree_VLOD_DP)
rmvd <- c("SRR29458765",  "SRR29458778",  "SRR29459358" , "SRR29463672" , "SRR29480632" , "SRR29489709",  "SRR5061676",  "SRR7283395")
rmvd %in% Fasttree_VLOD_DP_mid$tip.label

# Load metadata
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
serotypes <- read.table("Serotypes.txt", header=T)
CCs <- read.csv("combined_results_with_cc.txt") |> select(Sample, clonal_complex)
SCs <- read.csv("GBS_GWAS_db_core_clusters.csv") |> rename(Sample=Taxon, SC=Cluster)
STs <- read.delim("ST_results.txt") |>
  mutate(ST2 = str_remove(str_remove(ST,"\\*"),"\\?"))


# Load phenotypes
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
phenotypes <- read.table("phenotypes.txt", header=T)
phenotypes <- phenotypes |>
  rename(Sample =samples ) |> 
  mutate(Age_cat = ifelse(continuous<=7, "EOD", 
                          ifelse(continuous<=89, "LOD", "VLOD")))
# Prep metadata for tree
typing_data <- left_join(left_join(left_join(left_join(serotypes, CCs ), SCs), phenotypes), (STs |> select(Sample, ST, ST2)))
fewer5_SC <- which(table(typing_data$SC)<=5)
metadata_tree <- typing_data |>
  mutate(SC2= ifelse(SC %in% fewer5_SC, "other", SC))|>
  mutate(SC2= factor(SC2, level=c(1:12, "other")))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = str_remove(str_remove(GBS.SBG,"\\*"),"\\?"))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = ifelse(grepl("III-", Serotype2), "III", Serotype2))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = factor(Serotype2, levels=c("Ia", "Ib","II", "III", "IV", "V","VI", "VIII")))|> 
  rename("label" = "Sample")|> 
  filter(label %in% Fasttree_VLOD_DP_mid$tip.label)

# Fix missing CCs
ref_ST_cc_df <- rbind(unique(metadata_tree|> filter(!grepl("\\*", ST), !grepl("\\?", ST)) |> select(ST, clonal_complex)), 
                       data.frame(ST= c(1750, 2107, 137, 1809, 235, 482, 1946, 2106, 234),
                                  clonal_complex=c("cc17", "cc17", "cc17", "cc23", "cc1", "cc17", "cc17", "cc19", "cc23")))

metadata_tree_v0 <- left_join(metadata_tree |> select(-clonal_complex), ref_ST_cc_df |> rename(ST2=ST)) |> 
  mutate(clonal_complex = case_when(
    label == "SRR29440471" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29458952" ~ "cc17",
    label == "SRR29459527" ~ "cc1",
    label == "SRR29476238" ~ "c459",
    label == "SRR29480489" ~ "cc17",
    label == "SRR29489178" ~ "cc17",
    label == "SRR29489593" ~ "cc1",
    label == "SRR29489703" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29506764" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29506975" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29508494" ~ "cc1",
    label == "SRR31502751" ~ "cc452",
    label == "SRR5063593" ~ "cc19",
    TRUE ~ clonal_complex # keep existing value for all others
  )) |> 
  mutate(clonal_complex = ifelse(ST2 %in% c(4,16,932), "No_CC", clonal_complex))


# Join metadata and tree 
Fasttree_VLOD_DP_mid_metadata <- full_join(keep.tip(Fasttree_VLOD_DP_mid, metadata_tree_v0$label), metadata_tree_v0 , by = 'label')


# Prepare heatmap data for phylo
## Serotype
Metadata_Serotype = metadata_tree_v0 |> select(Serotype2)
row.names(Metadata_Serotype) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_Serotype)= c("1")
## CC
Metadata_CC= metadata_tree_v0 |> select(clonal_complex)
row.names(Metadata_CC) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_CC)= c("2")
## Age category
Metadata_Age_cat= metadata_tree_v0 |> select(Age_cat)
row.names(Metadata_Age_cat) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_Age_cat)= c("3")

# Prepare colors for phylo
SC_colors <- c("#dbdb8d", "#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd","#8c564b", "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f", "#bcbd22", "#17becf", "#f7b6d2",  "#c5b0d5", "#c49c94", "black")
Serotype_colors <- c(color("muted")(9),"#D55E00" , "grey")
names(Serotype_colors) <- levels(Metadata_Serotype[,1])
CC_colors <- carto.pal(pal1 = "pastel.pal" ,n1 = 13)
Age_cat_colors <- c("#004488", "#DDAA33", "#BB5566")

# Save clean version of data
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
write.csv(metadata_tree_v0 |> 
  select(-GBS.SBG, -SC2, -ST)|>
  rename(Serotype = Serotype2, 
         ST = ST2), "Clean_Typing_data.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

# Compare serotype, clonal_complex, and SC2 distribution across binary and continuous age of onset classification
```{r}
# Prepare your data as before:
barplot_data <- metadata_tree_v0 |> 
  select(label, clonal_complex, SC2, Serotype2, binary, continuous, Age_cat) |>
  mutate(binary = factor(binary, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("EOD", "LOD+VLOD")))

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  if (p < 0.01)  return("**")
  if (p < 0.05)  return("*")
  return("ns")
}

# The function
sig_barplot <- function(barplot_data, fill_var, colors, plot_title = NULL) {
  fill_var <- rlang::ensym(fill_var)       # Tidy eval for use in aes()
  tab <- table(barplot_data[[as.character(fill_var)]], barplot_data$binary)
  test <- fisher.test(tab, simulate.p.value = TRUE)
  p_label <- sprintf("Fisher's Exact p = %.2g", test$p.value)
  stars_label <- p_to_stars(test$p.value)
  
  ggplot(barplot_data, aes(x = binary, fill = !!fill_var)) +
    geom_bar(position = "fill")  +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(),
    limits = c(0, 1.13),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)
  ) +
    labs(
      x = "Age of Onset Category", y = "Proportion", 
      fill = rlang::as_label(fill_var),
      title = ifelse(is.null(plot_title), 
                     paste("Distribution of", rlang::as_label(fill_var), "by Age of Onset (EOD vs LOD+VLOD)"), 
                     plot_title)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = 1.05, yend = 1.05), size = 0.6) +
geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = 1, y = 1.01, yend = 1.05), size = 0.6) +
geom_segment(aes(x = 2, xend = 2, y = 1.01, yend = 1.05), size = 0.6) +
annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 1.1, label = p_label, size = 5) +
annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 1.06, label = stars_label, size = 7)
}


# Example usage:
sig_barplot(barplot_data, "clonal_complex", CC_colors)
sig_barplot(barplot_data, "SC2", SC_colors)
sig_barplot(barplot_data, "Serotype2", Serotype_colors)


# logistic regression 
## Serotypes
serotypes <- unique(barplot_data$Serotype2)
results <- data.frame(Serotype = character(),
                      OR = numeric(),
                      CI = character(),
                      p.value = numeric(),
                      stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

for (s in serotypes) {
  barplot_data$ThisSerotype <- barplot_data$Serotype2 == s
  tbl <- table(barplot_data$binary, barplot_data$ThisSerotype)
  ft <- fisher.test(tbl)
  or <- ft$estimate
  ci <- ft$conf.int
  ci_str <- paste0("(", round(ci[1], 2), ", ", round(ci[2], 2), ")")
  pval <- ft$p.value
  results <- rbind(results, 
                   data.frame(Serotype = s,
                              OR = round(or, 2),
                              CI = ci_str,
                              p.value = pval,
                              stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
}

# Multiple testing correction
results$Bonferroni <- p.adjust(results$p.value, method="bonferroni")
results$sig_bonf <- ifelse(results$Bonferroni < 0.05, "*", "")
# Clean up output formatting
results$p.value <- signif(results$p.value, 3)
results$Bonferroni <- signif(results$Bonferroni, 3)

print(results)
```
